themes.name: Mandate Setup and Onboarding Friction
themes.definition: Difficulties and failures when attempting to set up bank mandates, complete KYC verification, authenticate OTPs, or start a new SIP mandate.
themes.addressability_reason: Groww can directly redesign onboarding workflows, offer debit card/UPI mandate alternatives, and provide real-time mandate status tracking.
example_needs: [setup_friction|setup_failed] Smooth upload process for the SIP mandate form
[setup_friction|started] Easier SIP mandate setup via debit card rather than internet banking

themes.name: Involuntary Payment Failures and Refund Delays
themes.definition: Issues where automated SIP debits fail, bounce charges occur unexpectedly, money is deducted without unit allotment, or refunds are delayed.
themes.addressability_reason: Groww can optimize payment gateway retry logic, send timely pre-debit notifications, align debits with salary dates, and automate instant refund processing.
example_needs: [payment_failure|lapsed_involuntary] Prompt refund for failed SIP deductions
[payment_failure|unknown] Accurate debit dates matching the stated SIP schedule without unexpected bounce charges.

themes.name: SIP Flexibility and Modification Options
themes.definition: The need to pause, modify investment amounts, change debit dates, or step-up active SIPs without cancelling the existing mandate.
themes.addressability_reason: Groww can build self-serve product features allowing users to pause, edit, skip, or step-up active SIPs seamlessly in the app.
example_needs: [income_change|paused] Pause feature for all mutual funds instead of cancel only
[setup_friction|checking] Modify active AMC SIP amount without deleting it.

themes.name: Negative Returns and Market Downturn Anxiety
themes.definition: Investor disappointment and loss of confidence triggered by negative returns, flat market performance, or falling portfolio values.
themes.addressability_reason: Groww can't change markets, but it can explain in plain language what a dip means for a SIP and set expectations at the start, without advice, return promises or fear.
example_needs: [negative_returns|considering_stop] Positive returns after 3 years of investing
[negative_returns|checking] Assurance on getting principal or returns back if market drops
review_changes: human review 7 Nov: addressability 1->2: explaining what a dip means for a SIP is education, not advice (was {'addressability': 1, 'addressability_reason': 'Groww cannot control market movements or promise principal protection without making inappropriate return guarantees or offering financial advice.'})

themes.name: Fund Switching and Platform Migration
themes.definition: Friction experienced when transferring SIPs from regular to direct plans, migrating holdings from external platforms, or setting up systematic transfer plans (STP).
themes.addressability_reason: Groww can build automated CAS import engines, clear regular-to-direct conversion utilities, and seamless platform switching flows.
example_needs: [fund_switch|restarted] Seamless transfer from regular to direct mutual fund SIPs
[fund_switch|restarted] Guidance on how to transfer SIP from Groww to AngelOne.

themes.name: Understanding Returns Numbers
themes.definition: Does not understand the returns shown (XIRR, absolute return %, NAV, current vs invested value) or how they are calculated.
themes.addressability_reason: Groww can explain each number in plain language on the screen where it appears, without advice or return promises.
example_needs: Clear explanation of how XIRR is calculated
Total portfolio returns in percentage format
review_changes: human review 7 Nov: split from portfolio_tracking_and_reporting_discrepancies, which mixed user comprehension (36 items) with app data errors (53 items)

themes.name: Wrong or Delayed Portfolio Data
themes.definition: The app shows wrong or late data: NAV not updated, units/balance mismatch, missing or delayed folio/holding updates.
themes.addressability_reason: Groww can fix data sync and show clear 'last updated' status.
example_needs: Accurate balance and return tracking without discrepancies
Timely NAV updates
review_changes: human review 7 Nov: split from portfolio_tracking_and_reporting_discrepancies; node C because data errors are trust issues (taxonomy C)

themes.name: Comprehension of SIP Mechanics and Platform Charges
themes.definition: Lack of clarity regarding how SIP auto-debits work, direct vs regular plan differences, exit loads, expense ratios, tax rules, and platform fee structures.
themes.addressability_reason: Groww can provide clear contextual tooltips, fee breakdowns, and objective educational content within the transaction flow.
example_needs: [confusing_numbers|checking] Clear understanding of platform charges vs regular fund charges
[confusing_numbers|started] Clarity on whether SIP instalment amounts can be changed or must remain fixed.
review_changes: human review 7 Nov: node E->C: confusion is a voluntary-lapse driver (decomposition C) (was {'node': 'E'})

themes.name: Redemption and Liquidity Payout Delays
themes.definition: Friction, slow processing times, or lack of clarity around redeeming mutual fund units and transferring funds to the user's bank account during cash needs.
themes.addressability_reason: Payout speed should be fixed for users, but it is not a continuation lever; stopping/redeeming must stay as easy as today.
example_needs: [liquidity_need|redeemed] Faster redemption payout within two days instead of five
[app_trust_issue|redeemed] Timely credit of redeemed mutual fund money to bank account.
review_changes: human review 7 Nov: node E->C, addressability 3->1: redeem-and-stop is branch C, but faster payouts don't improve continuation and making exits harder would be a dark pattern (was {'node': 'E', 'addressability': 3, 'addressability_reason': 'Groww can display live tracking for redemption settlement timelines, clarify payout schedules, and streamline withdrawal processing.'})

themes.name: Investment Discovery and Guidance Requests
themes.definition: Requests for curated fund recommendations, top SIP picks, portfolio reviews, and beginner guidance on selecting the best mutual funds.
themes.addressability_reason: Providing specific investment recommendations or fund picks crosses into investment advisory, which requires regulated advisory structures.
example_needs: [none|started] Fund recommendations for good SIPs to invest in.
[none|checking] Needs recommendations on which SIP to choose.

themes.name: Advanced Features and Custom Order Types
themes.definition: Demands for sophisticated platform features including SWP, Stock SIPs, Gold SIPs, goal tagging, fund comparison tools, and custom watchlists.
themes.addressability_reason: Groww can prioritize building product capabilities like Systematic Withdrawal Plans (SWP), Stock SIPs, and goal tagging into the core platform.
example_needs: [none|continued] SWP/STP feature availability
[none|continued] Ability to add custom alias names or goal tags to SIPs

themes.name: Customer Support Responsiveness and Platform Uptime
themes.definition: Frustration stemming from unhelpful automated support, lack of direct phone helplines, system glitches, and slow issue resolution.
themes.addressability_reason: Groww can expand customer support channels, add live callback capabilities, and improve app stability and backend infrastructure.
example_needs: [app_trust_issue|stopped] Responsive customer support to resolve transaction delay issues quickly
[app_trust_issue|checking] Working dashboard and responsive customer care
review_changes: human review 7 Nov: node E->C: app/trust issues map to C in the taxonomy (was {'node': 'E'})

themes.name: Other Unmet Needs
themes.definition: Miscellaneous user requests and edge cases that do not map cleanly to the core SIP setup, execution, or tracking journey.
themes.addressability_reason: Addressability depends on the specific edge case, regulatory policy, or custom feature requested.
example_needs: [other|considering_stop] RBI overseas investment limit enhancement to accept fresh SIPs.
[other|paused] NRI status account conversion
